object.description: Setup: build with a valid map key, device with internet access and location permission. Steps: 1. Finish a session with at least 2 location fixes. 2. Read the Summary screen. 3. Open the same workout from History. 4. Repeat with a workout of exactly 1 location fix. Expected: Summary and Workout Detail each show a map containing the workout's location fixes, for the 2-fix and the 1-fix workout.
